title: A session on shiv's Mac runs the acts the cloud refuses: protection writes, branch deletes, closing his PRs
why: shiv, Oct 30 16:14 CDT (via coordinator): pick a on the setup gaps.
note:
Waits on shiv sharing a folder through Remote Control. Then a session attached to that folder runs the acts cloud sessions are refused. Done check: one such act runs from the Mac session with no hand-off to shiv.
Placed first among build steps (triage, c55 pass Nov 1): one folder share unblocks about ten steps that need the owner's computer (page item 144, share-folder-remote-control).
Nov 1 17:56 CST: the app's Add folder is offered only on local sessions, so the owner could not add one. Path left: run claude remote-control in the folder from a terminal (page item 144). The owner reports cloud sessions working on his folders before; not yet explained.
Unblocked, Nov 1 18:10 CST: the owner runs claude remote-control in C:\Users\ShivamSemwal\Clones\claude-settings (worktree spawn mode, page item 144 done). It shows as bridge environment env_012b1TvWKjGGYvBq8y5o2JLo (SSEM-DPROMAX16), active; a session started there with create_session runs on his PC. The folder list for attaching this session stays empty: that list is a different path. Needs a fresh login (claude auth login) without CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN set, which Remote Control refuses.
Blocked again, 18:10 CST: create_session on the bridge was refused (elevated_session_untrusted_device), and guard trust-card-in-build refuses the trust card from a cs-build session. Meanwhile the owner pastes the coordinator's brief into a session he starts on his PC (update check, guard.log reads, delete merged branches, c44 confirm). Open: how the owner marks the PC trusted for cloud sessions.
